Showcase is a storage for your online content!

quotes.title: Show HN: >>>>>>>>>>> ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎   [video]

quotes.text:
Hi HN! I made this free app called Showcase, which lets you bookmark and organise any content (videos, posts, articles, images — from anywhere) into one visual space. I like to say that it's Dropbox but for social media (+other) content.

It came out of a super annoying problem: I’d save stuff online——tweets, blog posts, YouTube videos, articles——but could never actually find anything again. Bookmarks were scattered across apps, and I was wasting way too much time hunting stuff down or just losing it entirely.

With Showcase everything’s easy to organise, super visual, and you can choose to keep content private or share full pages with friends. Use the Share Extension to bookmark with a single tap, or just drag, drop, or paste content directly onto your canvas; both on desktop and mobile. It’s great for hobbies, research, projects——whatever you’re into.

Imagine if you could store your online content together in one place. Well now you can!

1 min demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ehGolVAHm8U
App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/showcase-co/id6740991352?platform=iphone
Desktop version: https://showcase-app.co
